question: Within the frozen 90-day top_fraction=1.0, nine-slot low-prior-ATR V1.7 account, does filtering actual confirmation entries by the directional distance to the original opposite Monday 1.618 reference relative to original stop risk improve the funded account?
single_variable: minimum available planned reward room at actual entry, measured as directional opposite-reference distance divided by original absolute entry-to-stop distance

account.priority_feature: frozen signal prior_atr_pct ascending; simultaneous order uses the existing capacity runner
account.target: frozen original 2R resting limit on the 75% partial
account.runner: exact frozen tp_r=0 cloud/stale/hour-gap/series-tail path on the remaining 25%
account.entry: frozen exact next-1H-open fill after each completed UTC 12H confirmation
account.stop: exact per-event original touched-side Monday 1.618 stop

room_geometry.source: tested geometry fields in the frozen week-target target_paths.csv.gz; select one fraction=0.5 row per event because the reference distance and original risk are invariant across target fractions
room_geometry.denominator_unit: quote-price units; absolute original entry-to-stop distance
room_geometry.eligibility_timing: at the actual next-1H-open entry; use only the original opposite reference and stop already fixed by the completed signal
room_geometry.controls: a matched control is retained only when its frozen actual parent signal passed the candidate room screen and the control is rankable in the original 90-day top_fraction=1 arm at its own entry; the control's own room ratio is not screened

candidates.meaning: frozen 90-day top_fraction=1.0 baseline with no additional room gate

selection.objective: highest development ending account capital among candidates satisfying every registered gate
selection.fallback: reuse no_room_filter if no candidate meets all development gates
selection.best_dev_growth: report the highest development account capital regardless of qualification

costs.resting_target: maker at the frozen original 2R limit

execution.framework: VectorBT via existing cloud_close_slots.run and frozen reward-account/scale-out adapters
execution.accounting: one shared 1000U account, nine concurrent slots, low-prior-ATR entry ordering
execution.baseline: reuse top_fraction=1.0 leadership metrics and funded/hourly ledgers; verify cash reconciliation; do not replay baseline
execution.new_candidates: evaluate the three room filters sequentially; run matched-control, paired-signal, and +5bp taker-slippage checks only for the selected and development-best candidates

limits.fills: reuses frozen V1.7 OHLC and resting-limit fill assumptions; no queue-position or non-fill model
limits.capacity: no order-book depth or market-impact model
limits.liquidation: exchange-specific maintenance-margin tiers and liquidation are not modeled
limits.later_periods: 2025 and 2026 are disclosed after development selection and do not affect the pick
